label: DiskStation DS1823xs+ 8-bay NAS
description: 8-bay desktop NAS with 10GbE built in: two 1GbE RJ45 ports plus one 10GBASE-T port, and a dedicated 1GbE out-of-band management port. A PCIe 3.0 slot takes 10/25GbE or Fibre Channel cards.
notes: Onboard per Synology's port table: 1GbE (RJ-45) x2, 10GbE (RJ-45) x1, 1GbE (RJ-45) for OOB x1. The 10G port is 10GBASE-T copper, not a cage. The OOB port is management-only - it is a separate network and cannot carry storage traffic. PCIe 3.0 slot for further 10/25GbE cards.
